verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair question for a payroll and finance SaaS that holds customer data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The Content-Signal marker in gusto.com's robots.txt only signals how crawlers may use Gusto's public website content, not customer data, so it earns no credit.
